card.name: Between first and last names
card.fires_on: Part of a person's name after the first name, such as a middle name, initial, or the start of a surname, where a surname comes next. Seen in author credits, reviewer lines and citations.

modes.label: Middle name or initial
modes.description: A middle name or initial sits between a first name and the surname still to come.
modes.example: Also reviewed by Linda J<<.>> Vorvick, MD, Medical Director

modes.label: Start of a surname
modes.description: The first piece of a surname, or a name split into pieces, just before the rest of the surname.
modes.example: Prebble was replaced with Samuel<< Barr>>on, who was quite ill.

card.writes: It favors given names such as Kathryn, Jacqueline and Judith and suppresses surnames such as Smith, which fits a spot partway through a full name.
card.plain: It fires inside a person's full name, after the first name and before the surname is finished.
